messages:
amelia: Heads up — seeing a weird billing spike for some streaming sessions in us-west-2. Replays show short proxy heartbeat losses around reconnects. Suspect double-counting when the session reconnects and we re-send the tail chunk.
raj: can you paste an example session id + logs?
amelia: sess=abc123
ops-bot: alert: High provisional_token_usage for customer: acme-corp (75% above baseline)
amelia: minimal logs:
```
PROXY: hb lost for sess abc123 at 14:02:13
CLIENT: reconnect sess abc123 new_conn=ef45 at 14:02:14
SERVER: resume offset=0 truncated=true toolcall_id=null
```
raj: truncated=true — sounds like we treated resumed stream as new start and recharged tokens from beginning.
jordan: is this a toolcall case? toolcall_id=null but some paths call tool after resume which causes extra charge.
sophie: quick idea: mark provisional tokens as tied to session token+connection_id pair and only confirm on final ACK from server. If reconnect causes new_conn, don't confirm earlier provisional until confirmed by backend ledger.
tim: that affects latency for low-latency clients — can we do conservative confirm on final chunk only? Also console UX for customers will show provisional spikes which is ok.
raj: telemetry change needed: include proxy_conn_id, resume_offset, truncated flag in token events. Also add 'resume_reason=heartbeat_loss' tag.
amelia: agree. We also need a reconciliation job that dedups charges by session token + earliest_confirmed_offset.
jordan: edge: partial toolcall invoked before resume then tool completes after resume — how to attribute? Suggest attribute toolcall to absolute token offset rather than connection id.
sophie: implementation sketch:
```
- On resume: emit event {session_id, conn_id, resume_offset, resume_reason}
- Ledger: when confirming tokens, dedupe by (session_id, offset_range)
- Toolcalls: record absolute offsets so confirmations map to absolute ledger slots
```
raj: console change: show provisional vs confirmed on timeline with hover for conn_id so customer can see which reconnections caused provisional credits.
ops-bot: deploy: canary to prod-1 at 20:30 UTC
amelia: thanks — I'll file a tiny RFC and add metrics to daily dashboard. Anyone want to pair on the ledger dedupe job tomorrow?
tim: I'll take pairing tomorrow 10am PT.
